Usage: ai-bdd [options] [command]

Turn plain markdown documents into executable acceptance tests.

Options:
  -V, --version                 print the version
  -c, --config <path>           path to the config file (default:
                                ai-bdd.config.{ts,mjs,js,json})
  -h, --help                    display help for command

Commands:
  init [options]                write ai-bdd.config.ts (or .json),
                                docs/example.md, .gitignore entries and
                                .ai-bdd/plans/
  compile [options] [docs...]   extract features and scenarios from stale docs
                                into reviewable plans
  status [options]              show plan freshness, coverage and review state
                                (no model calls)
  show [options] [id|docUri]    render plan elements as Gherkin-like text with
                                source quotes
  review <action> <ids...>      accept, reject, pin or unpin features and
                                scenarios
  run [options] [selectors...]  run scenarios; the first run characterizes,
                                later runs replay recordings
  verify-run <runDir>           recompute artifact hashes and the manifest
                                digest of a run directory
  prune [options]               delete recordings whose scenario no longer
                                exists in any plan
  doctor [options]              check Node, config, drivers, model reachability
                                and plan freshness
  help [command]                display help for command
